ctx.x: You said Fletcher's wife used to play trumpet. What did people think in some days of a woman who played an instrument?
Leora, her name was Leora. What did they

think? Well, I tell you, in those days, there weren't many colored people in Harlem. And there -- a good deal of white people came there, and you had a mixed orchestra, a couple of white women was in there. And they didn't think anything, everything was all right. We didn't have any crime in those days. We fellows used to get off from work around 3:00 or something like that, we'd go by the Amsterdam or we'd go to the Rhythm Club. Because if you're working downtown, -- now, here's something.
